These four were ably backed up by Doub, George Beecham and Ron Garwood and we won the team title by 21 points to 26. Our Middlesex walkers - Cadogan A.C. - gave battle to the might of that County to such good effect that they finished 3rd behind the supplemented strength of Highgate.
Mike Heard also ran well in finishing 40th and Arthur Bruce ran pluckily on a damaged foot to be 56th, with Eric Bishop 65, R.Garwood 112, L.C.Bishop 117, and L.A.Adams 138.
